name: node-datachannel
description: Stand-in for node-datachannel, the native WebRTC addon that bittorrent-tracker's client pulls in (through @thaunknown/simple-peer and webrtc-polyfill). SwarmCast runs only bittorrent-tracker/server, which never loads it. The real package's install script downloads a prebuilt binary from GitHub and, when that fails, builds it from source, which fails too (pipeline run 41664754395). Loading this stand-in throws.
